### ✨ MW2 (v2026.3.2)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **Unlock All Campaign Maps & Episodes** — Unlocks all campaign episodes, maps & multiplayer locks
- **Unlock All Heroes & Unlimited Charges** — Unlocks all DLC/Challenge Heroes & unlimited charges
- **Unlock Premium, Forge & All Features** — Enables ProfilePremium, FeaturesManager & unlocks Forge/MP
- **Zero Skill Cooldown (Instant Reuse)** — Resets skill cooldowns & special skill timers every tick
- **Zero Skill Energy Cost** — Forces SkillItem energy cost = 0 & keeps mana full
- **Infinite Skill Energy (Max Energy)** — Locks Ally Player.skillEnergy at maxSkillEnergy
- **Max Morale (5 Stars) & 0 Morale Timer** — Forces Ally moralePoints to max & moraleTimer to 0
- **Instant Capture / 0 Enemy HP on Attack** — Drains Enemy/Neutral building units to 0 when attacked by Ally
- **Freeze Enemy Unit Production** — Stops Enemy villages from producing new units
- **Enemy HP / Unit Scale** — Scales Enemy building unit count & production rate
- **Ally Invincibility (God Mode)** — Ally buildings take 0 damage from Enemy attacks
- **Ally Village Production Multiplier** — Multiplies unit production speed for Ally villages
- **1-Hit Kill Bosses & Destructible Walls** — Sets FlyBomb/Mouro Boss health & DestructibleObject HP to 1
- **Boost Ally Attack Damage** — Multiplies Ally Player, UnitGroup & Unit attack coefficients
- **Ally Damage Multiplier** — Scales Ally GetDamageCoefficient & unit attack power
- **Boost Ally Building & Unit Shield** — Multiplies Ally GetShieldCoefficient & BaseModule defense
- **Ally Defense Multiplier** — Scales Ally shield & building defense coefficients
- **Weaken Enemy Damage & Strip Enemy Shield** — Reduces Enemy attack power by 95% and strips Enemy defense
- **Ally Tower Fire Rate Multiplier** — Multiplies TowerModule fire rate for Ally towers
- **Instant Victory (Win Current Battle)** — Calls Player.Victory(true, false) on Local Player
- **Game Speed (Time.timeScale)** — Scales UnityEngine.Time.set_timeScale (1.0x - 5.0x)
- **Target Frame Rate (FPS)** — Sets UnityEngine.Application.targetFrameRate

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
